subject.title: feat(read): persist inbound media to workspace staging

question: Should inbound `media://inbound/` attachments become session-owned workspace artifacts for non-sandbox agents, and if so which existing workspace-safe staging boundary owns their lifecycle?
rationale: This is a new persisted workspace behavior with cross-turn and security-boundary consequences; code review cannot choose the supported product contract for workspace aliases and cleanup ownership.

options.title: Adopt session-owned staging
options.body: Define a canonical safe-write staging owner, make cleanup session-specific, and document the artifact lifetime before landing.

options.title: Keep inbound media ephemeral
options.body: Reject workspace persistence and preserve the current turn-scoped media behavior until a broader attachment-staging design is approved.

recommendation.title: Adopt session-owned staging
recommendation.body: Define a canonical safe-write staging owner, make cleanup session-specific, and document the artifact lifetime before landing.

likelyOwner.reason: Likely routing candidate for agent-runtime and workspace-lifecycle product boundaries, pending direct history confirmation.
